name: SCIBENCH
description: An expansive benchmark suite designed to systematically evaluate large language models' reasoning capabilities on complex college-level scientific problems, including an open set of diverse scientific problems and a closed set from undergraduate exams.
reputation: A well-known science-reasoning benchmark used in many LLM evaluation papers, especially for college-level STEM reasoning.
notes: Addresses limitations of prior benchmarks by including collegiate-level scientific problems beyond elementary arithmetic and multiple-choice formats.
